notes.title: Gigapocalypse Full Release Update: New Gigas, New Stages, Endings and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/ec5f4f66047464e343ad6b51f6edacbf9372b86f.png[/img]

Greetings Kaijū lovers,

The time has finally come: The full release update for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] has been published! You can expect 3 new Gigas (Gold King, Blight Queen and Ezer), 2 new stages and of course the update brings the campaigns to an end. With 9 Gigas in the game, that makes a total of 9 different endings - so there's a lot to do:

[previewyoutube=CdYeqOt70LA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Finally here is what to expect from todays full release update:[/b]
[list][*] 3 New Gigas (Gold King, Blight Queen, and Ezer)
[*] 2 New Stages
[*] Dozens of new Pets
[*] 9 different endings (One end per Giga)
[*] Put a limit to how much Mutation points can be gained from each stage on Endless Mode
[*] Strengthen some Giga skill damage
[*] Various bug fixes and optimizations[/list]
I hope you'll like it, and of course don't hesitate to let me know your honest feedback in [url=https://discord.com/invite/fXqHbQQvnc]Discord[/url] or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1543240]Steam Community Hub[/url]. I am really looking forward to it!

And I would definitely like to [b]THANK YOU[/b] for accompanying me until the full release of [b]Gigapocalypse[/b]! It was an exciting and educational journey and it was just so much fun! Thank you for giving me so much feedback and making [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] what it is today! ❤️

Stay safe, enjoy the update and see you on top of the leaderboards!
Goody

notes.title: 🎃 Trick or treat: Welcome to the Gigapocalypse Halloween Update! 🎃
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/23fa0a115dde6302e65c64fc080c4e9eb1a49de9.png[/img]

Spooky greetings, Kaijū lovers!

It's that time of the year again - it's trick or treat time! Jack-o’-lantern is grinning everywhere, scary and beautiful costumes lurking around every corner and there is the annually Steam Halloween Sale of course!

And that's why [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] is currently not only available with a [b]33% discount[/b], there is also spooky new content in the game: [b]PumpKing Manor[/b]! Collect the Pumpkin Key by destroying buildings and use it to challenge PumpKing Manor on Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty. If you are able to destroy the Pumpkin pinata before the timer ends, a pet is guaranteed as a reward. And the higher the difficuly is, the higher is the level of the pet you will be granted.

[b]There are also some improvements and fixes coming with this update:[/b]

[list][*] Beastiary feature to view all the collected pets added
[*] Pets have a chance to randomly level up when getting them. The higher the stage, the bigger is the chance for a leveled-up pet
[*] Credits screen added
[*] Moved the "Customize" button from the Giga selection menu to upgrade menu
[*] Added a distance progress interface in the bottom interface
[*] Various interface updates
[*] Various bug fixes[/list]
Have a spooky Halloween everyone!
Goody

notes.title: Gigapocalypse Early Access Update 2: Endless Mode, new Skins and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/5afa55c45b1a8e82b29e23ee2064a2ed79b192d6.jpg[/img]

Greetings Kaijū lovers,

I just released the second roadmap update for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b]! ːsteamhappyː Thank you all so much for the awesome feedback and your positive reviews – it's really great to see that you people enjoy playing my game.

So here's the list of new content, fixes and changes that come with the second Early Access update. I hope you'll like it, and of course don't hesitate to let me know your honest feedback in [url=https://discord.com/invite/fXqHbQQvnc][b]Discord[/b][/url] or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1543240][b]Steam Community Hub[/b][/url]. I am really looking forward to it!

[b]Finally here is what to expect from todays update:[/b]
[list][*] [b]Endless Mode reworked and launched:[/b] Previously in Beta, destruction points gained are determined by the percentage difficulty, for example : 40% increased in difficulty translate to 40% bonus destruction points gained, in the new version, this bonus will be no longer given.
[*] [b]New leaderboards for the Endless Mode:[/b] The Suburs, Wild West, Knight Age, and Lost Island now have new leaderboards, the BETA leaderboards are accessible for viewing purpose only.
[*] [b]Added a Fixed cooldown to all skills:[/b] For example Azurath's Blizzard cooldown won't get lower than 10 seconds.
[*] [b]18 cool new skins![/b]
[*] [b]Added a "Pet" button to manually pet baby Giga[/b]
[*] [b]Added a "blocking" effect to buildings that are now able to block Giga attacks[/b]
[*] [b]Various bugs fixed[/b][/list]
I'm looking forward to your feedback on the update. Meanwhile I'll keep working on the next one – there's still some more content to be done. Stay tuned for more details! ːsteamhappyː

Stay safe, enjoy the update and see you on top of the leaderboards!
Goody

notes.title: Gigapocalypse Early Access Update 1: Terror From Outta Space!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/d10422401fbe7b3a62c58e9667143035f09dd492.png[/img]

Dear Kaijū lovers,  

I´m super excited to announce the brand new first roadmap update for [b]Gigapocalypse[/b] is live now! Thank you all so much for the great feedback and your positive reviews – it´s great to see that people really seem to enjoy playing the game I´ve been working on for quite some time now.  

So here´s the list of new content, fixes and changes. I hope you´ll like it, and of course don´t hesitate to let me know your honest feedback in Discord our in the Steam Community.  

[b]NEW CONTENT:[/b]
[list][*] [b]Act 2 “A Void in the Space”:[/b] the second act is now available, including new Gigas and new locations 
[*] [b]Three new space Gigas:[/b] Veteris, Nullisar and Nebular have entered the ring, each with unique skills and different play styles
[*] [b]Two new stages:[/b] Unleash your Gigas in the two new stages “Knight Age” and “Lost Island” with new enemies, traps and epic boss fights!
[*] [b]Space pets:[/b] If there are space Gigas, there should also be space pets. Period.
[*] [b]New skins:[/b] Get your Giga a new dress. Looks great and also comes with cool advantages for your Giga
[*] [b]Endless Mode BETA:[/b] Wanna see how powerful your Giga really is? Check out the brand new endless mode (Beta) and make it to the top of the leaderboard!
[*] Achievement Decoration
[*] New Achievements[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40105546/d5d1b54439011011d188226feba5b6ddbc8ae19f.png[/img]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list][*] Added DoomTerra ranged attack 
[*] Added additional weak point for Hell Train boss 
[*] Mutation points and eggs will still be rewarded when exiting the stages manually  
[*] Reduce the visual effect of RageZilla's Fiery Presence skill[/list]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Skill points bug 
[*] DoomTerra smashing stuck animation 
[*] Various bugs and visual improvement [/list]
I´m looking forward to your feedback on the update. Meanwhile I´ll keep working on the next update – there´s still some more content to be done 😊 Stay tuned for more details. 

Thanks again for your support and your feedback so far – you rock!  
Stay safe, enjoy the update and see you on top of the leaderboards!
Goody
